audience: Oura Ring wearers who want to look at their own sleep, readiness and activity data

useCases.title: Review your sleep over a period of nights
useCases.text: The AI reads daily sleep and sleep documents over a date range. You get sleep scores per night and the main trends.

useCases.title: Check readiness and stress for a period
useCases.text: The AI reads daily readiness, stress and resilience documents over a date range. It sums up how recovered you were and which days were heavy.

useCases.title: See steps, activity and workouts
useCases.text: The AI reads daily activity, workout and session documents for a date range. You see movement per day and your exercise.

useCases.title: Look at heart-rate samples and ring battery
useCases.text: The AI reads heart-rate samples over a datetime range, for example to find the lowest overnight value, and ring battery readings or the latest level.

useCases.title: Set up, renew or remove a webhook subscription
useCases.text: The AI lists the webhook subscriptions, creates one for a callback URL, renews one before it expires, or deletes it. Oura verifies the URL before it activates.
